title: Copper mugs
text: Copper mugs. I am a "new" fan of the moscow mule drink and thought it would be nice to have these when making at home... they are hammered copper... the the two mugs come with a handy matching copper 1 1/2 oz shot glass.. No recipes though as others had mentioned in older reviews... I did purchase some copper cleaner for the outside of the mug - it was offered with the purchase, as an additional purchase.  I washed them with warm soapy water and immediately dried them.  They are sort of medium weight... not super thin or super thick. The handles are large, wide - lots of room between your fingers and the mug itself.  I think they will gain a patina of sorts with age and I am ok with that.  I will say that when the arrived, inside the box they were wrapped with some tissue like paper that smelled like moth balls to me... I was greatly relieved that when washed the copper mugs did not any longer smell like moth balls. I actually purchased 2 sets.  I they will last a lot longer than my fascination with moscow mule drinks.  I always update my reviews if new info would be useful.
